scope: Lexical class-engine/card operational fields and original ordinary spell objects. Includes threshold/healing/exclusion references, not only maximum-stat changes. Historical originalText is retained but does not qualify an operational card by itself.

classRecords.text: Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, does not remove Wounds, and does not restore a dead creature unless a card explicitly says it resurrects. No Cleric feature provides unlimited permanent HP or resource restoration outside encounters. Temporary HP does not stack with itself; use the higher value. Resurrection and corpse-based effects have explicit use limits and cannot generate repeatable corpses, XP, loot or Conviction.

card.name: Anointed Guardian
card.rangeAndTarget: First ally within 30 feet to fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less
card.effect: Anointed Guardian. Tags: protection, bishop. The first qualifying ally in an encounter gains a ward for 2 rounds. The first time during each round that ally takes damage, reduce that damage by PB + M, minimum 0. The ward does not prevent conditions attached to an attack unless the damage reduction itself invalidates them under another rule.

source.originalText: Anointed Guardian: First time an ally drops below 20% HP per combat, grant them a 30% damage reduction shield for 2 rounds.

card.name: Aura of Grace
card.frequency: Healing once/own regular turn; critical reduction once/ally/round
card.effect: Aura of Grace. At the start of your regular turn during a real encounter, you may pay 1 RP to heal S HP to up to 3 living allies within 15 ft below half maximum HP. You must be conscious. Separately, once per ally per round when an ally in the aura suffers a critical hit, reduce its added critical damage by one damage die, minimum 0 extra dice. No unlimited free healing.

source.originalText: Aura of Grace: Allies in range resist critical hits and gain minor HP regen.

card.name: Divine Rebirth
card.rangeAndTarget: One ally revived by your Cleric feature
card.duration: Instantaneous plus temporary HP for 1 minute
card.effect: Divine Rebirth. Tags: saint, resurrection. When one of your Cleric features returns an ally from death, you may use Divine Rebirth. That ally returns with half its maximum HP instead of the feature's normal returned HP and gains S + M temporary HP for 1 minute. It removes no Wounds and cannot affect a creature that was not actually dead.

source.originalText: Divine Rebirth: On revive, ally returns with 50% HP and a temporary resistance shield.

card.name: Merciful Sacrament
card.effect: Merciful Sacrament. Tags: saint, sacrament. When you start Sacrament and at least one living ally inside its initial zone is at or below one-quarter maximum HP, you may reduce that Sacrament's Conviction cost to 0. Its RP cost and all other requirements remain. Because no Conviction is spent, this waived cost does not vent Dissonance.

source.originalText: Merciful Sacrament: Sacraments cost no Conviction if used on an ally under 25% HP.

card.name: Unyielding Light
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to six living party members within 30 feet, including you
card.effect: Unyielding Light. Tags: saint, emergency, healing. When one damage event would leave every conscious living party member within 30 feet at 0 HP, resolve that damage, then before ordinary death-save progression each qualifying living creature at 0 HP regains floor(maximum HP/3), minimum 1. It cannot revive a creature killed outright and removes no Wounds. This one emergency trigger may resolve even if that event incapacitates you, provided you remain alive; it grants no other actions while incapacitated.

source.originalText: Unyielding Light: Once per day, prevents party wipe and restores 30% HP.

card.name: Mass Healing Light
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to six living allies within 30 feet
card.effect: Mass Healing Light. Tags: saint, healing. Roll S d8 + M once. Each target regains that amount. A target below half maximum HP when chosen regains an additional 1d8 HP. Roll that bonus once and apply it to all qualifying targets. This cannot revive the dead or remove Wounds.

source.originalText: Mass Healing Light: Channel divine energy to heal all allies within 30 feet, with increased effectiveness on those most wounded.

card.name: Corrupt Divinity
card.effect: Corrupt Divinity. Tags: cultist, debuff, control. The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it takes -1 on attack rolls and saving throws. It repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on success. If a non-player NPC at or below one-quarter maximum HP fails the initial save by 10 or more, it is also Charmed by you until the end of its next turn. This never permanently converts allegiance, changes beliefs or overrides a player character's agency.

source.originalText: Corrupt Divinity: Channel corrupted divine energy to weaken enemies and potentially convert them to your cause.

card.name: Wyrmhide
card.rangeAndTarget: Self while above half maximum HP
card.effect: Reduce each damage instance by 2 and gain advantage on CON saves against Bleed, Burn and Poisoned. No blanket condition immunity; effects already present persist and ordinary nonstacking reduction applies.

source.originalText: Wyrmhide: Gain +10% DR and immunity to Bleed/Burn/Poison while above 50% HP.

card.name: Flesh to Ash
card.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius sphere centered at a point within 60 feet
card.effect: Flesh to Ash. Tags: mage-spell, lich, necrotic, damage. Creatures of your choice in the area make Constitution saves. A target at half maximum HP or more takes S d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. A target below half maximum HP instead takes 2 S d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. Determine the threshold before rolling damage.

source.originalText: Flesh to Ash: Create an AoE burst that doubles damage if target is below 50% HP.

card.name: Soulbound Ritual
card.rangeAndTarget: One of your destroyed bound elite undead companions within 30 feet or its inert binding token
card.effect: Soulbound Ritual. Tags: mage-spell, lich, companion, resurrection. Return one destroyed Boneflayer, Dreadblade or Wraithbound to an unoccupied space within 30 feet at half its maximum HP. It gains S+M temporary HP for 1 minute. The returned companion remains subject to the shared Companion Command limit and cannot create a corpse, XP, loot or resource event if destroyed again.

source.originalText: Soulbound Ritual: Revive a fallen undead pet with bonus stats.

classRecords.text: Temporary maximum-HP reductions caused by Monk features do not stack on the same creature; use the largest reduction from your Monk features. Maximum HP cannot be reduced below 1. Unless a card specifies an earlier end, the reduction lasts until the creature completes a short or long rest. Restoring maximum HP does not restore current HP. These effects are temporary combat trauma, not unstated permanent injuries.

Healing from Monk cards cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless explicitly stated. Permanent HP recovery and Ki generation cannot be farmed outside encounters. Resurrection effects are explicitly limited-use. No Monk card can instantly kill a target merely because a descriptive source used language such as Death Touch; death continues to follow the game's ordinary damage and dying rules.

card.name: Ribcrusher Strike
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your unarmed strike
card.duration: Until target completes a short or long rest
card.effect: Ribcrusher Strike. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack, max-hp. After an unarmed strike hits, spend 2 Ki. The target makes a Constitution save. On failure reduce its maximum HP by S+M, minimum maximum HP 1. This reduction follows the common non-stacking maximum-HP rule and is restored after a completed short or long rest without restoring current HP.

source.originalText: Ribcrusher Strike: Heavy strike, reduces enemy max HP by 10% (2 Ki).

card.name: Bone-Breaking Strike
card.duration: Until target completes a short or long rest
card.effect: Bone-Breaking Strike. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack, max-hp. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit, the target makes a Constitution save. On failure reduce its maximum HP by 2 S+M under the common non-stacking maximum-HP rule. This creates no persistent broken-limb injury; the maximum returns after a completed short or long rest without restoring current HP.

source.originalText: Bone-Breaking Strike: Deliver a powerful blow that can temporarily reduce the target's maximum health.

card.name: Deathless Silence
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three enemies you can perceive within 60 feet
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn; max-HP reduction until rest
card.effect: Final — Deathless Silence. Tags: hero, shadow, final, teleportation, max-hp, weave. Until the start of your next regular turn you cannot be targeted by opportunity attacks or Reactions. Teleport adjacent to up to three different chosen enemies in sequence and make one unarmed strike against each. On each hit, the target makes a Constitution save. Failure reduces its maximum HP by 4 S+M under the common non-stacking rule and suppresses one non-core defensive passive it possesses until the end of its next turn; the Director identifies an applicable visible passive before the save. This does not disable core class engines, legendary rules or creature type traits.

source.originalText: Final – Deathless Silence: Untargetable 1 turn → teleport to 3 enemies and apply Void Palm (max HP -25%, passive disable).

card.name: Death Touch
card.effect: Death Touch. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, finisher. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit add 3 S d8 necrotic damage. If the target began the strike at or below one-quarter maximum HP, it also makes a Constitution save; on failure add another 2 S d8 necrotic damage. This never causes automatic death, bypasses no ordinary dying rules and creates no permanent injury beyond the damage actually dealt.

source.originalText: Death Touch: Legendary technique that can potentially kill a weakened target instantly by stopping their heart.

classRecords.text: Healing from Oracle features cannot exceed maximum HP, resurrect the dead or remove Wounds unless a feature explicitly says so. Temporary HP never stack. Encounter-only regeneration and drain cannot be farmed outside meaningful combat. Corpse effects create no XP, loot, RC or repeatable corpse resources unless expressly stated.

card.name: Spiral-Touched — Boon III
card.duration: Until start of next regular turn
card.effect: 1/long rest when damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, instead regain floor(max HP/4), minimum 1, and phase out until the start of your next regular turn; while phased you cannot be targeted, affect other creatures or activate Revelations.

value.name: Spiral-Touched
limitations: You sometimes respond to events before they happen, causing confusion in social situations
You occasionally experience time differently than others, potentially missing turns in combat (5% chance)
You cannot maintain concentration on mundane tasks for extended periods

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: See 1 round into the future during initiative (+3 initiative). Once per day, reroll a failed save as you briefly step outside the timestream.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to act out of turn once per combat. You gain resistance to time-based magic and aging effects.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you may instead phase out of time for 1 round, becoming untargetable and regaining 25% of your maximum HP. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: You exist in multiple timestreams simultaneously, allowing you to make two different actions in a single turn once per combat. Enemies attacking you have a 10% chance to hit your echo instead, causing the attack to miss.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: You gain the ability to create a time loop, resetting an entire combat encounter to its beginning state once per day. All allies retain knowledge of the original timeline, allowing them to make different choices.

value.source: rulebook — Example Curse: Spiral-Touched (only full curse tree in player rulebook)

card.name: Wound Eater — Boon III
card.rangeAndTarget: One dying hostile living creature touched
card.effect: 1/short rest as an Action touch one dying hostile living creature at 0 HP; that creature dies and you regain HP equal to one-quarter your maximum HP rounded down. It cannot trigger from summoned, trivial or staged creatures and removes no Wounds.

value.name: Wound Eater
value.blurb: Lives by wounds taken from the living, never by an easy cure
limitations: Natural healing and healing granted by another restore only half their usual amount to you
Before each long rest ends, you must drain life from a living foe or gain Exhaustion
Your flesh carries a hollow, withered look that makes many mortals recoil at first meeting

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: When you hit a living foe with a weapon or touch attack, drain 1d6 HP; you heal for half the amount drained. Undead and constructs are immune.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: When you reduce a living foe to 0 HP, regain 1 Revelation Charge. Resistance to necrotic damage from non-Revelation sources.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Once per short rest, siphon a dying enemy's remaining HP as a burst heal (up to 25% of your max HP). The Pale Ledger records their final breath.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Drain aura: at the start of your turn, living enemies within 2 tiles take necrotic damage; you heal for the total drained. You may suppress this aura in civilized areas.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, become a conduit of the unfinished hunger — all living enemies within 4 tiles lose 25% max HP; you heal for half the total. Allies are unaffected.

value.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

card.name: Wound Eater — Boon V
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three living enemies within 20 feet
card.effect: 1/long rest as an Action, up to three meaningful living enemies within 20 feet lose HP equal to the lesser of one-quarter their maximum HP or Oracle level+M; you regain half the total actual HP lost, capped at one-half your maximum HP. Allies, constructs, undead, trivial creatures and summons are unaffected.

value.name: Wound Eater
value.blurb: Lives by wounds taken from the living, never by an easy cure
limitations: Natural healing and healing granted by another restore only half their usual amount to you
Before each long rest ends, you must drain life from a living foe or gain Exhaustion
Your flesh carries a hollow, withered look that makes many mortals recoil at first meeting

boons.description: Once per short rest, siphon a dying enemy's remaining HP as a burst heal (up to 25% of your max HP). The Pale Ledger records their final breath.

boons.description: Drain aura: at the start of your turn, living enemies within 2 tiles take necrotic damage; you heal for the total drained. You may suppress this aura in civilized areas.

boons.description: Once per day, become a conduit of the unfinished hunger — all living enemies within 4 tiles lose 25% max HP; you heal for half the total. Allies are unaffected.

card.name: Burning Blood — Boon IV
card.activation: Triggered on first falling below half HP
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three enemies within 15 feet
card.effect: once per short rest when you first fall below half maximum HP, erupt in a 15-foot fire burst. Enemies make Dexterity saves, taking 2 S d6 fire on failure or half on success; you take no damage from this flare.

value.name: Burning Blood
value.blurb: Air kindles your spilled blood into a fire that harms friend and foe alike
limitations: When slashing or piercing damage wounds you, you and adjacent foes take 1d4 fire damage as your blood sparks
You cannot benefit from cold-based healing or resistances; your curse rejects the chill
Open wounds glow faintly, imposing −2 to Stealth until treated or until you rest

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Resistance to fire. Melee attackers take 1d4 fire damage when they hit you with a weapon attack. Your wounds smolder briefly — enemies within 1 tile take 1 fire damage when your blood first ignites each round.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to ignite your blood — your next Revelation deals +50% fire damage and cannot be extinguished by mundane means. While ignited, slashing and piercing damage against you no longer sparks fire on adjacent allies; the Crown's flame answers only to your will.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When your blood ignites from damage, allies within 2 tiles gain +10% weapon damage for 1 round as shard-fire answers your pain. You may extend the flare to 3 tiles by spending 1 Revelation Charge — enemies in the burst take 1d4 fire damage as embers leap from your wounds.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Blood flare: when reduced below 50% HP, erupt fire in a 3-tile burst (once per short rest). Enemies take fire damage; you are not harmed by your own flare.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, become a living pyre for 3 rounds — fire aura in 3 tiles; enemies take fire damage at start of turn; you heal 1d6 when an enemy takes fire damage from you. Allies in the aura gain fire resistance and treat your ignited blood as bright light that reveals hidden foes within 2 tiles.

value.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

card.name: False Life — Boon V
card.duration: Rise next turn; immunity two rounds
card.effect: 1/long rest when you are at 0 HP but not destroyed outright, appear dead until the start of your next regular turn. During that interval you are incapacitated. At the start of your next turn rise with floor(max HP/4), minimum 1, and gain necrotic immunity for 2 rounds. Undead within 15 feet treat you as non-hostile until you damage, control or overtly oppose them. Divination during the apparent-death interval returns one false but plausible state-description you choose; it cannot fabricate events outside your own condition.

value.name: False Life
value.blurb: Magic mistakes your living breath for death and answers accordingly
limitations: Healing spells cast on you without a successful Insight check have a 50% chance to fail; magic reads you as corpse-cold
Unless you suppress the curse, divination treats you as undead
Clerics of life-deities may hesitate to aid you without proof that you still breathe

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Advantage on saves vs death effects and negative energy. Once per long rest, when you would die, stabilize at 1 HP as your body feigns death perfectly.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Feign death perfectly for 1 minute — undead ignore you unless attacked; you remain conscious but motionless. Once per combat.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When reduced to 0 HP, remain conscious for 1 round before falling — you may move, speak, or cast one Revelation. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Necrotic resilience: +10% DR vs necrotic and negative energy. Undead attackers have 10% chance to miss you entirely, sensing kinship.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, return from death's threshold — after 1 round of appearing dead at 0 HP, rise at 25% max HP with immunity to necrotic for 2 rounds. Undead within 3 tiles treat you as kin until you act, and divination cast during your feigned death returns false results of your choosing.

value.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

card.name: Death's Threshold
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.duration: Until healed above half maximum HP
card.effect: The first time after a short rest that you fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less, activate Death's Threshold. Until you are healed above half maximum HP, reduce the first necrotic damage and first nonmagical weapon damage you take each round by S and gain +1 to your Revelation save DC. Undead enemies within 3 tiles take -1 on their first attack roll against you each round. The effect then ends and cannot reactivate until after another short rest.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Death's Threshold
value.description: When reduced below 25% HP, gain +10% necrotic resistance, +5% DR vs non-magical damage, and +1 to Revelation saves until healed above half HP (once per short rest) — the Pale Ledger marks you as owed, not finished; undead within 3 tiles hesitate to target you (−10% hit on their first attack each round while below threshold).

card.name: Ledger Unbound
card.rangeAndTarget: Enemies and up to 3 eligible corpses within 5 tiles
card.effect: Choose up to three enemies in range. Roll 4 S d8+M once; each target takes necrotic damage equal to the lesser of that roll or one-quarter its maximum HP, with a Constitution save for half. This blast cannot reduce HP below 1. Raise up to three nonsummoned corpses as 1-HP bone servants for three rounds. Once per round spend your shared companion Bonus Action to move and attack with ONE servant using your Revelation attack bonus for 1d8+S necrotic damage. Alternatively, your Reaction may sacrifice one servant to intercept a single-target attack against you; no attack is made by that servant that round. Servants grant no XP, loot, harvestable corpses or RC. For three rounds, up to three undead you already control add S damage to their one shared commanded attack and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. No extra creature turns or command budgets are created.

value.name: Ledger Unbound
value.description: Once per day, open the Pale Ledger across the battlefield — all enemies within 5 tiles must save or suffer 25% max HP necrotic damage as unfinished deaths are tallied; you may raise up to 3 fallen corpses as loyal bone servants for 3 rounds (each may attack once per round and intercept one hit meant for you). Undead you control during the effect gain +10% damage and +5% DR.

card.name: Crown Restored
card.effect: Manifest the Crown for 3 rounds. Once on each of your turns add 2 fire damage to one damaging attack or Revelation. At the start of each living ally's turn within 5 tiles, including yours, that ally regains 1d6 HP, at most three pulses per creature from this Final and never above maximum HP. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Flame Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. Free Revelations cannot recursively restore additional RC beyond the normal once-per-round Prophecy Trigger cap.

value.name: Crown Restored
value.description: Once per day, manifest the Crown of First Flame for 3 rounds: +2 fire damage on all attacks, allies within 5 tiles regenerate 1d6 per round, and you may cast Tier I fire Revelations at 0 cost once per round.

card.name: Verdant Pulse
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies you heal; emergency ally within 4 tiles
card.duration: Buff until end of ally's next turn; emergency instantaneous
card.frequency: Buff once per ally per short rest; emergency 1/encounter
card.effect: When one of your paid or finite Oracle effects restores HP to an ally who was below half maximum HP, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before the end of its next turn by S and adds 1 HP to one later finite healing effect during that period. Separately, once per encounter when a living ally within 4 tiles would be reduced to 0 HP without instant death, use your Reaction to leave it at 1 HP instead and end Frightened or Poisoned on it.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Verdant Pulse
value.description: Passive: when you heal an ally below 50% HP, they gain +10% resistances and +5% healing received until end of next turn (once per ally per short rest). Once per combat, when an ally within 4 tiles would drop to 0 HP, a verdant pulse blooms — they stabilize at 1 HP and end one minor condition.

card.name: Echo Strike
card.rangeAndTarget: Same target just hit by your weapon or touch attack
card.effect: Immediately after your weapon or touch attack hits, spend 1 RC. Copy half the triggering attack's unmodified rolled damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1, as damage of the same type to the same target. The echo is not another attack, cannot critically hit and copies no flat modifiers, conditions, resource gains or proc triggers. If this copied damage leaves the target below half maximum HP, regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round and never above maximum.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Time; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Echo Strike
value.description: Spend 1 charge: after you hit with a weapon or touch attack, an echo of the strike repeats at half damage on the same target (no extra charge); if the echo reduces the target below half HP, you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

card.name: Rewind Wound
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.duration: Healing instantaneous; protection until start of your next turn
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; same damage event can be rewound once
card.effect: Reference the most recent single damage event the target suffered since the start of its previous regular turn and restore HP equal to that event's actual HP damage, maximum Oracle level+M. If that exact event directly imposed one condition with a finite duration, remove that condition if it is still present and is not a Wound, curse, death state or permanent transformation. The ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1 and gains +2 initiative for the current round. If the recorded damage had reduced it below half maximum HP, regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round. Rewind does not undo attacks, spent resources, movement, deaths of other creatures or proc effects.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Time; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Rewind Wound
value.description: Spend 2 charges: touch ally within 1 tile — the Turning Spiral folds causality; undo the last instance of damage they took in the past round (restore HP, remove one condition inflicted by that hit if any); they gain +5% DR and +2 initiative until start of your next turn, and if the undone damage would have dropped them below half HP, you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

card.name: Merciful Smite
card.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
card.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack; up to 3 living allies within 10 feet of you
card.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
card.effect: Your Oath Smite deals radiant damage instead of adding a second Smite packet. After the Smite damage resolves, create a healing pool equal to half the actual radiant Smite damage dealt, rounded down, maximum S+M. Divide that pool among up to 3 living allies within 10 feet. Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, remove Wounds or trigger additional Smite or healing-copy effects.

originalObjects.value: Radiant — bonus radiant damage; heals nearby allies for a portion dealt

conductClauses: Never refuse a genuine plea for healing or protection when the oath can answer it
Set the saving of life before the taking of it, even when anger makes the latter easier
Offer defeated foes the mercy their surrender can bear, without abandoning those still in danger
Do not raise lethal force against the innocent or defenseless; strength was given to stand between them and harm

card.name: Blessing of the Meek
card.duration: Healing instantaneous; AC bonus until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: The target regains 2d6+M HP. If it was below half maximum HP before this healing, it also gains +2 AC until the start of your next regular turn. This spell cannot resurrect, remove Wounds or generate additional healing triggers beyond ordinary once-per-effect rules.

value.spell: Blessing of the Meek — heal + AC if HP < 50%

card.name: Channel Life
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and one living ally within 30 feet
card.effect: Choose X from 1 to Paladin level+M, limited so your current HP remains at least 1. Lose X HP; this loss cannot be reduced, redirected or prevented. The target regains X HP. This is a direct transfer, cannot exceed the target's maximum HP and cannot remove Wounds or create excess temporary HP.

value.spell: Channel Life — transfer HP from self to ally

card.name: Final Verdict
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature marked by you within 30 feet and at or below half maximum HP
card.duration: Instantaneous or empowerment until end of your next regular turn
card.effect: The marked target makes a Constitution save, taking 4 S d8 radiant damage on failure or half on success. On failure it also cannot regain HP until the end of its next turn. If that damage reduces it to 0 HP, use ordinary Downed/death rules; there is no percentage-HP execution. On success your next Smite against it before the end of your next turn uses maximum damage dice. This bounded damage replaces the source draft’s automatic reduction to 0 HP.

value.spell: Final Verdict — marked foe at or below half HP within 30 ft saves or drops to 0 HP; on success, your next smite deals max dice and they cannot regain HP until end of next turn

card.name: Death Touch — Malicious Execution
card.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
card.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; rider once per turn
card.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal necrotic damage equal to the declared Lay on Hands points. If the target was already at or below half maximum HP, it makes a Constitution save; on failure add S d6 necrotic damage. This rider never automatically executes or bypasses normal death rules.

card.name: Fearbrand
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
card.duration: Damage instantaneous; Frightened until end of next turn
card.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it takes 2 S d6 psychic damage and is Frightened until the end of its next turn; on success it takes half damage and is not Frightened. A target already below half maximum HP takes one additional d6 psychic damage. This creates no execution effect.

originalObjects.value: Fearbrand — increased damage to wounded; spread fear

card.name: Crown Undying
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three selected allies in your aura
card.effect: For three rounds apply Crown of Embers protection without consuming its short-rest use. Selected allies reduce their first damage each round by S and gain +1 on saves; this save bonus does not stack with Aura of the Crown. You may redirect from up to two selected allies each round, at most Paladin level+M damage total per round, without a Reaction. Original-target defenses apply once; redirected damage cannot be reduced again. Each protected ally then heals half the damage you actually absorbed for it, rounded down, maximum S+M per ally per round. This is a finite Final healing exception, cannot heal you, cannot exceed maximum HP, and cannot trigger another redirection or heal-copy chain. It does not reset the daily Lay on Hands pool.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 20; Oath of the Martyr King

originalObjects.value: Crown Undying — once per day, Crown of Embers lasts 3 rounds without concentration; damage you redirect heals the ally for half absorbed, allies in aura gain +1 saves while the crown persists, and you may redirect from two allies per round.

card.name: Talon Strike
card.duration: Instant; reduction until end next turn
card.effect: Make one claw attack; hit adds S d6 necrotic and reduces the next healing it receives by M, minimum 0. Applies once and ends. No arbitrary percent stacking or permanent maximum-HP reduction.

source.originalText: Talon Strike: Make a vicious attack that causes bleeding and reduces healing received.

card.name: Repair Pulse
card.duration: Instant; AC until start next turn
card.effect: Restore each half its maximum HP rounded down and+1 AC. Functional devices only; no construct resurrection, organic HP, resource or use resets.

source.originalText: Repair Pulse: Heal all drones, turrets, and party deployables for 50% HP and grant +1 AC to nearby allies.

card.name: Snap Rebuild
card.effect: Restore half its maximum HP. Uses original slot and original expiry; expired devices ineligible. Does not reset limited uses, modules, Overdrive, destruction triggers or bomb stock.

source.originalText: Snap Rebuild: Once per encounter, instantly redeploy any destroyed turret or pet with 50% HP.

classRecords.text: BRUTALITY PROGRESS. Begin each real encounter with Brutality Progress 0 and BT 0. Add actual damage you personally deal to meaningful hostile creatures to Brutality Progress, but a single damage event contributes no more than one-quarter of your maximum HP. Crossing cumulative thresholds equal to 25%, 50% and 75% of your maximum HP grants 1 BT each, subject to the BT cap. Crossing 100% triggers Transcendent as described below but does not create a fourth stored BT unless Stack Overflow or another feature raises the cap.

HEALING AND REGENERATION. Warrior healing cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Regeneration and repeated healing effects operate only during real encounters unless their card explicitly permits downtime healing. No corpse, summoned creature, trivial enemy or friendly target can be used to create infinite healing, serum doses or BT.

card.name: Brutality Sense
card.rangeAndTarget: Hostile creatures you can perceive within 60 feet
card.effect: Brutality Sense. You know when a visible hostile creature is at or below one-quarter of its maximum HP; it is Vulnerable for your Warrior features that specifically reference a marked vulnerable target. This does not reveal its exact HP or hidden resistances.

source.originalText: Brutality Sense: You can sense when an opponent is below 25% health, marking them as vulnerable.

card.name: Regenerative Mutation
card.cost: Spend healing amount from Mutation Recovery Reserve
card.duration: While at least one mutation is active in a real encounter
card.frequency: Once at the start of each regular turn
card.effect: Regenerative Mutation. At the start of your regular turn during a real encounter, if at least one mutation is active and you are below maximum HP, regain S+M HP. This regeneration functions only during a real encounter, cannot restore the dead or remove Wounds, and cannot be increased by remaining in initiative without meaningful opposition. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal only up to remaining reserve.

source.originalText: Regenerative Mutation: Heal 5% of your maximum health each round while at least one mutation is active.

card.name: Pain Empowerment
card.effect: Pain Empowerment. For every full 10% of your maximum HP currently missing, add +1 damage to one weapon or natural-weapon damage roll on each of your turns, maximum +5. Determine the bonus immediately before the chosen damage roll. Healing can reduce the bonus during the encounter. It does not increase mutation retaliation, ongoing damage or area effects.

source.originalText: Pain Empowerment: Gain +5% damage for each 10% of health you are missing.

card.name: Flesh Warden
card.effect: Increase maximum HP by 2 per Warrior level while equipped. Equipping raises maximum only, never current HP. Unequipping clamps current HP to the reduced maximum if necessary; it does not subtract another amount from current HP. Repeated swaps cannot heal.

source.originalText: | Flesh Warden | +2 HP per level |

card.name: Adrenal Floodgate
card.effect: When you first fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less, regain 2d8 HP and end either Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered on yourself.

source.originalText: | Adrenal Floodgate | Once per encounter, heal 2d8 HP and remove 1 condition when you drop below 25% HP |

card.name: Mythic Carapace
card.duration: Until encounter ends, mutation ends or you fall below one-quarter maximum HP
card.effect: Gain DR 3 against all damage and immunity to Bleed, Poisoned and Burn-style ongoing fire effects. Once per encounter when one hit deals more than 20 actual damage after mitigation, gain 1 BT and refresh the remaining duration of your other active mutations to 3 rounds. It grants no serum-profile refresh.
card.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Vital; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Mythic Carapace | While this is active:
- +3 DR flat
- Immune to Bleed, Poison, and Burn
- Once per combat, when you're struck for more than 20 damage: immediately gain +1 BT and refresh all active mutations
- Lasts until the end of combat or you fall below 25% HP |

card.name: Butcherform Chassis
card.duration: 3 rounds or until below one-quarter maximum HP
card.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee attack beyond other Extra Attack effects, respecting the one-additional-full-Action guard because this is part of the same Action. Your melee criticals add one extra weapon damage die beyond normal critical dice, not triple total damage. Once per round when you personally kill a meaningful hostile with a melee attack, restore one consumed prepared serum dose, never above reserve capacity.
card.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Combat; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Butcherform Chassis | While active:
- Gain +2 attacks per round
- Crits deal triple damage
- Melee kills instantly refresh 1 serum or 1 mutation use
- Lasts for 3 rounds or until you're below 25% HP |

classRecords.text: ABJURATION, provisional completion for the omitted eighth row: once per round after you cast an Abjuration spell, gain temporary HP equal to PB until the start of your next regular turn. CONJURATION: creatures summoned by your Wizard spells gain +1 maximum HP per Wizard level. DIVINATION: once per long rest reroll one failed saving throw and use the new result. ENCHANTMENT: when a creature fails its initial save against one of your Enchantment spells, a printed control duration of at least 1 round may last one additional round, but every normally allowed repeat save still occurs. EVOCATION: when casting an area Evocation spell, exclude one creature from its initial damaging area; that creature automatically succeeds and takes no damage if success normally halves damage. ILLUSION: gain +2 on concentration saves made to maintain Illusion spells. NECROMANCY: once per turn during a real encounter when a hostile non-summoned creature dies from your Necromancy spell, gain 1 temporary HP; it is not permanent healing. TRANSMUTATION: after casting a Transmutation spell, gain +5 feet Speed until the end of that turn.

Flesh Ascendant's bonus applies after the listed base statistics: every undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard level. If at least two of your undead creatures are active, each gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. This does not increase the standard-minion or elite-pet caps.

card.name: Flesh Ascendant
card.effect: Flesh Ascendant. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, undead. Each undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard class level. While at least two of your undead creatures are active, each also gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. These bonuses apply after the common standard-minion and elite-pet statistics and do not increase companion caps or command frequency.

source.originalText: Flesh Ascendant: All undead gain +2 HP per Wizard level, if 2+ undead are active, gain +1 AC and Save

sourceObject.name: Exploit Weakness
sourceObject.description: At level 7, a combatant seeks wounded enemies for the listed critical chance.
sourceObject.effect: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19–20 against creatures below half their hit point maximum.

sourceObject.description: Your bond with your familiar is stronger.
sourceObject.effect: Your familiar gains hit points equal to your level and can attack using your spell attack bonus.

sourceObject.effect: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each character level, including levels already gained.

sourceObject.effect: Your hit point maximum increases by 2 per character level when you take this feat, and by 2 whenever you gain a level thereafter.

When you take necrotic damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that instance by half (once per short rest). While below half your hit point maximum, you have resistance to poison damage.
